observation: Every Gate->graph dispatch signed hmac-sha256 was refused by CEG Gate-only ingress (HTTP 403, surfaced by Gate as 502 worker_transport_failed). CEG log: 'Gate-only ingress rejected packet: hmac-sha256 cannot prove Gate authorship here; Gate must sign with ed25519'.
meaning: CEG (staging) fails closed on an HMAC-signed Gate packet: positive evidence for the no-HMAC-downgrade requirement at CEG ingress. The HMAC profile cannot exercise CEG, so its per-case results are not evidence about the product and are not recorded as case verdicts.
